objective: General-purpose Testbox Studio with import mapping, editable executable steps, datasets, portable projects, Python export, NFR and visible playback

features.name: Portable mixed project and editable executable step model
features.evidence_summary: Workspace format 2 loads legacy format 1 without changing records/source steps; explicit Save preserves a v1 backup.

features.name: Generic Selenium runner, assertions, setup and cleanup
features.evidence_summary: Generic runner, assertions, setup/cleanup, timers, dataset iterations; Chrome fixture covers success, failure, evidence and cleanup. Full command/context and regression audit remains.

features.name: Steps editor, reorder, duplicate, enable/disable and undo
features.evidence_summary: Editable action/target/value/expected/phase/timeout, duplicate/reorder/toggle, drag/drop, undo/redo; Tk editing and snapshot tests pass.

features.name: CSV/XLS/XLSX import wizard, sheet/header/column mapping and preview
features.evidence_summary: Sheet/header/mode/mapping/preview and reusable profiles; explicit Gradebook adapter; prose imports as disabled notes. More encoding/large-file UI checks remain.

features.name: Dataset and variable editors with data-driven execution
features.evidence_summary: Editable data and variable tables preserve empty strings/spaces; imported three-row login example executes three real Chrome cases.

features.name: Locator library, checking and element highlighting
features.evidence_summary: Editable locator library; read-only ambiguity/visibility checks and reversible highlighting in a separate owned browser; real Chrome and Tk checks pass.

features.name: Visible/headless, slow playback, pause/resume, step and breakpoints
features.evidence_summary: Visible/headless, slow/highlight, pause/resume/next, enforced breakpoints and stop with cleanup; real child-runner test proves interrupted work is not PASS. Reports retain planned/completed counts and NOT_RUN steps.

features.name: Environment profiles and preflight readiness
features.evidence_summary: Read-only origin connection checks block browser launch on unreachable website; project environments save/apply URL, browser, viewport and timeout. Wider UI audit remains.

features.name: Per-step and per-dataset reports, screenshots and exports
features.evidence_summary: Row-aware JSON/CSV, planned and completed steps, standalone HTML, Tk report viewer, evidence ZIP and credential masking; real deliberate-failure demo retained.

features.name: Standalone Python/unittest export for Level 1 and Level 2
features.evidence_summary: Standalone ZIP includes Selenium/unittest runtime, Level 1 Python items, Level 2 JSON items and runtime CSV inputs/oracles. Real browser checks run outside repository, preserve CSV failures, prove external locator changes and copied uploads; standard unittest discovery works.

features.name: Compatibility and elapsed-time NFR configuration for both levels
features.evidence_summary: NFR dialog and selected-case browser/level/repetition matrix execute actual exported Level 1 Python and Level 2 JSON programs. Per-case elapsed boundaries and limits are inserted into immutable snapshots; summary includes completeness and per-sample acceptance. Native Gradebook supports compatibility; elapsed mode requires editable steps.

features.name: Reusable templates, browser element picker/recorder, conditions and loops
features.evidence_summary: Reusable templates with JSON exchange; owned Chrome recorder/picker with password placeholders, parameterized text and manual assertions; safe structured conditions and bounded repeats. Native capture/replay, document navigation, non-activating picking, both-level exported control flow, template execution and GUI tests pass. 68 development checks pass; final audit remains.

invariants: Open existing Gradebook workspaces and preserve their data, expected assertions, folders and manual sources
Browser execution uses an immutable snapshot and only begins after an explicit Run
Missing variables, incomplete execution, assertion failures and cleanup failures cannot be reported as PASS
Existing user workspace files and running app instances are not overwritten or closed automatically
General-purpose projects do not require Moodle-specific columns or credentials
current_stage: Complete: all twelve feature scopes and original completion gates verified. The known Moodle TC-003-036 application FAIL remains unchanged.
